question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing sweeper, Fred is playing left back, and Gertrude is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Finally, Bob and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right midfielder
(C) striker
(D) benchwarmer
(E) sweeper
(F) left back
(G) right back
solution:
Each row lists the positions of (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude), in that order.
Initial: (left winger, right midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, sweeper, left back, right back)
1. Bob ↔ Claire: (left winger, striker, right midfielder, benchwarmer, sweeper, left back, right back)
2. Claire ↔ Dave: (left winger, striker, benchwarmer, right midfielder, sweeper, left back, right back)
3. Alice ↔ Bob: (striker, left winger, benchwarmer, right midfielder, sweeper, left back, right back)
4. Alice ↔ Claire: (benchwarmer, left winger, striker, right midfielder, sweeper, left back, right back)
5. Claire ↔ Bob: (benchwarmer, striker, left winger, right midfielder, sweeper, left back, right back)
6. Eve ↔ Fred: (benchwarmer, striker, left winger, right midfielder, left back, sweeper, right back)
7. Bob ↔ Eve: (benchwarmer, left back, left winger, right midfielder, striker, sweeper, right back)
Alice is the benchwarmer, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
